sentences.text: You may know this feeling, you wake up to multiple unread notifications on your mobile phone.
sentences.translation: 你大概体会过这种感觉：一觉醒来，手机上是好几条未读通知，

sentences.text: Your calendar calendars are packed with meetings, sometimes double or triple booked.
sentences.translation: 日程表被会议塞得满满当当，有时还撞车、被双重甚至三重预定。

sentences.text: You feel engaged, you feel busy, in fact you feel productive.
sentences.translation: 你觉得自己很投入、很忙，事实上还觉得自己很高效。

sentences.text: But the end of it all, something still feels missing.
sentences.translation: 但到最后，心里总还觉得缺了点什么。

sentences.text: You try to figure out what it is, but before you do, the next day starts all over again.
sentences.translation: 你想弄明白到底缺什么，可还没等你想清楚，第二天又开始了。

sentences.text: That was how I felt two years ago.
sentences.translation: 两年前，我就是这样的状态。

sentences.text: I felt stressed, I felt anxious, I felt a bit trapped.
sentences.translation: 我感到压力很大，感到焦虑，感到有点被困住了。

sentences.text: The world around me was moving very quickly, and I didn't know what to do.
sentences.translation: 周围的世界飞速运转，我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.text: I started wondering to myself, how do I keep up with all this?
sentences.translation: 我开始问自己：我该怎么跟上这一切？

sentences.text: How do we find fulfillment in a world that's literally changing as fast as we can think?
sentences.translation: 在这个变化快到、甚至比我们思考还快的世界里，

sentences.text: Or maybe even faster?
sentences.translation: 我们怎样才能找到满足感？

sentences.text: I start looking for answers.
sentences.translation: 我开始寻找答案。

sentences.text: I spoke to many people, I spoke to my friends, I spoke to my families.
sentences.translation: 我和很多人聊过，和朋友聊过，和家人聊过，

sentences.text: I even read many help books.
sentences.translation: 甚至读了很多励志自助书籍。

sentences.text: But I couldn't find anything satisfactory.
sentences.translation: 但我找不到任何令人满意的答案。

sentences.text: In fact, the more help books I read, the more stressed and anxious I became.
sentences.translation: 事实上，我读的自助书越多，就越感到压力和焦虑。

sentences.text: It was like I was feeding my mind with junk food, and I was becoming mentally obese.
sentences.translation: 那感觉就像我在给自己的大脑喂垃圾食品，让自己精神上变得臃肿。

sentences.text: I was about to give up.
sentences.translation: 我几乎要放弃了，直到有一天，

sentences.text: Until one day, I found this, the dao dou dowdurjing the book of the way and its virtues.
sentences.translation: 我找到了它——《道德经》，《道德与美德之书》。

sentences.text: This is an ancient Chinese philosophy classic that was written more than 2,600 years ago.
sentences.translation: 这是一部中国古代哲学经典，写于 2600 多年前。

sentences.text: And it was by far the thinnest and the smallest book on the bookshelf.
sentences.translation: 它是书架上最薄、最小的一本，

sentences.text: It only had 81 pages, and each page had a short poem.
sentences.translation: 只有 81 页，每一页都是一首短诗。

sentences.text: I remember I flicked to one particular poem.
sentences.translation: 我记得我翻到其中一首，

sentences.text: Here it is.
sentences.translation: 就是这首。很美，

sentences.text: It's beautiful, isn't it?
sentences.translation: 不是吗？

sentences.text: Let me read it out to you.
sentences.translation: 让我读给你们听：

sentences.text: The supreme goodness is like water.
sentences.translation: 上善若水。

sentences.text: It benefits all things without contention in.
sentences.translation: 水善利万物而不争，

sentences.text: Dwelling it stays grounded.
sentences.translation: 处众人之所恶，

sentences.text: In being, it flows to deaths.
sentences.translation: 故几于道。居善地，

sentences.text: In expression, it is honest.
sentences.translation: 心善渊，与善仁，

sentences.text: In confrontation, it stays gentle.
sentences.translation: 言善信，

sentences.text: In governance, it does not control any action alliance to timing.
sentences.translation: 政善治，事善能，动善时。夫唯不争，

sentences.text: It is content with its nature, and therefore cannot be faltered.
sentences.translation: 故无尤。哇，

sentences.text: Wow, I remember when I first read this passage, I felt the biggest chills down my spine.
sentences.translation: 我记得当我第一次读到这段时，我感到一股巨大的战栗沿着脊背流下。

sentences.text: I still feel that today reading it to you guys.
sentences.translation: 直到今天，读给你们听时，我依然有这种感觉。

sentences.text: My anxiety and stress just suddenly disappeared.
sentences.translation: 我的焦虑和压力突然间就消失了。

sentences.text: Ever since that day, I've been trying to apply the concepts in this passage to my day
sentences.translation: 从那天起，我一直试着把这段话里的理念应用到我的日常生活中。

sentences.text: Life.
sentences.translation: 生活。

sentences.text: Today, i like to share with you three lessons I learned so far from this philosophy of water.
sentences.translation: 而今天，我想和大家分享我迄今为止从这种“水之哲学”中学到的三点。

sentences.text: Three lessons that I believe have helped me find greater fulfillment in almost everything
sentences.translation: 这三点，我相信它们帮助我在所做的几乎每一件事中，

sentences.text: It also taught me that instead of promoting my glory and success, it is so much more satisfying
sentences.translation: ”它还教会我，与其宣扬自己的荣耀和成功，不如去宣扬别人的成功与荣耀，

sentences.text: To promote the success successing glory of others.

sentences.text: And meaningful to help other people overcome their challenges so they can succeed.

sentences.text: With a humble mindset, I was able to form a lot richer connections with the people around

sentences.text: Me.

sentences.text: I became genuinely interested in the stories and experiences that make them unique and
sentences.translation: 生活变得有趣多了，

sentences.text: Magical.

sentences.text: Life became a lot more fun because every day I'll discover new quirks, new ideas and new
sentences.translation: 因为每一天我都会发现新的怪癖、新的想法、新的解决方案，

sentences.text: Solutions a problem.
sentences.translation: 以及我以前不知道的问题—

sentences.text: I didn't know before all thanks to the ideas and help from others.
sentences.translation: —这一切都要感谢别人的想法和帮助。

sentences.text: All streams eventually flow to the ocean because it is lower than them.

sentences.text: But I think it gives us the capacity to remain grounded, to be present, to learn from and
sentences.translation: 而我认为，它也赋予了我们一种能力，让我们保持踏实、活在当下，

sentences.text: When I was thinking through this, I began to understand why I was feeling stressed out

sentences.translation: 而是转向“获得更多和谐”，我们就能在自己的努力中找到更大的满足感。

sentences.translation: 我从水之哲学中学到的第三课，是关于开放。

sentences.text: Water is open to change.
sentences.translation: 水愿意拥抱变化：

sentences.translation: 随着温度不同，它可以是液态、固态或气态；

sentences.text: In fact, it's water's ability to adapt and change and remain flexible, that made it so
sentences.translation: 事实上，正是水这种适应、变化、保持灵活的能力，

sentences.translation: 让它历经千古而长存，尽管环境发生了种种变化。

sentences.translation: 在紧凑的时间里解决一个业务难题。

sentences.text: Now we can stake behind closed doors and continue to be paralyzed by our limiting belief,

clips.summary: 讲者用大家熟悉的场景开场：一觉醒来手机满是未读通知，日程被会议塞满甚至双重、三重预定。你感觉自己投入、忙碌甚至高效，但内心深处总觉得缺了点什么，还没想明白，第二天又开始了。
两年前的讲者就是这样：压力大、焦虑、感觉被困住。周围世界飞速运转，她不知怎么办，开始自问如何跟上一切、如何在变化快过思考的世界里找到满足感，并开始寻找答案——和朋友、家人聊，读自助书。

keyPoints.phrase: how do I keep up with all this
find fulfillment in a world that's literally changing as fast as we can think
synonyms: find fulfillment in a fast-changing world
find satisfaction in a changing world

clips.summary: 但她找不到满意的答案，读的自助书越多越焦虑，像在给大脑喂垃圾食品、精神上变得臃肿。她几乎要放弃，直到找到《道德经》——一部写于 2600 多年前的中国古代哲学经典，是书架上最薄最小的一本，只有 81 页，每页一首短诗。

keyPoints.phrase: the more help books I read, the more stressed and anxious I became
feeding my mind with junk food
the book of the way and its virtues

clips.summary: 她翻到「上善若水」这首诗：水善利万物而不争，处众人之所恶。第一次读到这段话，她感到一股巨大的战栗沿脊背流下，焦虑和压力突然消失。从此她一直把这段话的理念应用到日常生活中，今天要分享从「水之哲学」中学到的三点。

keyPoints.phrase: the supreme goodness is like water
synonyms: the highest good is like water

keyPoints.phrase: the biggest chills down my spine
three lessons I learned so far from this philosophy of water

clips.summary: 第一课是谦逊。水总往低处流，滋养其他植物、养活所有动物，却从不刻意吸引注意，也不索取任何回报或认可。它是谦卑的，但没有水这份谦卑的奉献，我们所知的生命可能就不存在。

keyPoints.phrase: doesn't draw any attention to itself

clips.summary: 谦逊教会她几件事：与其装作什么都会，不如坦然说「我不知道，我想学更多，我需要你的帮助」；与其宣扬自己的荣耀与成功，不如宣扬别人的成功，那更令人满足；与其只顾自己领先，不如帮助他人克服困难、让他们成功，那更有意义。

keyPoints.phrase: I don't know, I want to learn more and I need your help
synonyms: I don't know, I want to learn

keyPoints.phrase: help other people overcome their challenges

clips.summary: 怀着谦逊的心态，她能和人建立丰富得多的连接，真正对别人独特而迷人的故事感兴趣，生活有趣多了。所有溪流最终都流向大海，因为大海比它们都低——谦逊赋予了水力量，也赋予我们保持踏实、活在当下、从身边人的故事中学习并被改变的能力。

keyPoints.phrase: all streams eventually flow to the ocean

clips.summary: 第二课是和谐。水流向岩石时会从旁边绕过去，它不沮丧、不生气、不烦躁，事实上几乎没什么情绪。面对障碍，水总能不靠强求、不靠冲突地找到出路。讲者由此明白自己当初为何压力重重——她在对抗环境，被「必须成功、证明自己」的执念吞噬，而非与之和谐相处。

keyPoints.phrase: finds a solution without force, without conflict

clips.summary: 强迫事情改变，结果什么都没变、只更沮丧。而当她把关注点从「获得更多成功」转向「获得更多和谐」，立刻重新平静专注。她学会只专注能控制的事、与环境协作。《道德经》说「道常无为而无不为」——正如水无需强求、无需冲突就能找到出路。

keyPoints.phrase: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished
find a solution without force or conflict

clips.summary: 第三课是开放。水愿意拥抱变化：随温度可成液、固、气三态，随容器可成茶壶、杯子或花瓶。正是这种适应、变化与灵活，让水历经环境变迁而长存。今天的世界也在不断变化，我们也要不断重塑、更新技能以保持价值——就像黑客松中，获胜的往往是愿意学习、清空重来、互相帮助应对变化的团队。

keyPoints.phrase: adapt and change and remain flexible
open to learn ... open to unlearn

clips.summary: 生活在某种程度上就像一场黑客松，呼唤每个人站出来、敞开心扉、激起涟漪。我们可以躲在门后继续被自我设限的信念麻痹，也可以敞开心扉享受旅程。谦逊、和谐、开放这三个词的英文首字母恰好是 H、H、O——H₂O，成为她的人生指导原则。每当压力、空虚或焦虑时，她只问一句：「如果是水，它会怎么做？」

keyPoints.phrase: step up, to open up and cause a ripple effect

clips.summary: 讲者把这个简单而有力的问题——灵感来自一本远在比特币、金融科技和数字技术出现之前写成的书——分享给大家，它让她的生活变得更好。她邀请大家试试看，告诉她是否有效，并感谢听众。

keyPoints.phrase: inspired by a book written long before the days of bitcoin
changed my life for the better
try it and let me know how it works for you
synonyms: see if it works for you
